audience: field-service and workforce teams that schedule orders, timesheets and allocations in Assignar

useCases.title: Review the orders for a period and their clients
useCases.text: List orders filtered by client, status or dates. Open an order and its client to see who the work is for.

useCases.title: See who is booked on an order
useCases.text: List allocations to see which user or asset is booked on an order, and when. Open the user or asset to read its record.

useCases.title: Review timesheets with worker and order details
useCases.text: List timesheets with their worker, order, times and charge codes. Open one timesheet to read its details.

useCases.title: Check inductions, skills and leave before a shift
useCases.text: List the inductions, the skills and the leave requests in Assignar. Check them before you plan a shift.

useCases.title: Read site diaries and submitted forms
useCases.text: List site diaries, filtered by date. List the submitted dockets and forms to review their results.

useCases.title: Create a client and an order for it
useCases.text: Create a client with its name and company name. Then create an order for that client with an owner, a start date and an end date. This writes live scheduling data.
